text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an All-Way Stop Control not be installed at the intersection of Cathedral Bluffs Drive and Earl Road as the existing conditions do not meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has a stop control facing the eastbound Earl Road approach of this T-type intersection.
Scarborough Community Council deferred consideration of the report (December 12, 2017) from the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District until its meeting on April 4, 2018.
